name: verid
description: Evidence-verified, hook-enforced TDD harness for Claude Code
author: Anh Tran

scripts.build: esbuild hook=src/hook.ts cli=src/cli/main.ts --bundle --splitting --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outdir=dist --log-level=warning "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
